capabilities: Render date and date-range code blocks as month calendars
Color-code up to 40 ranges and single dates with an optional legend
Infer missing years from the note creation date and previously resolved entries
Mark today's date with a hand-drawn oval
Stretch calendars to the full note width via a setting
disambiguation: Not a daily-notes or scheduling calendar; it only renders date and date-range code blocks inside notes.
extras: Manual installation only (from GitHub releases). Extensive developer documentation covers build, publishing, and a Docker-based visual regression test suite; minimum Obsidian version is 1.5.7. Invalid entries report the line number and reject the whole block; more than 40 entries shows an error.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize dates or date ranges written in notes as calendar views.
summary: Renders fenced date and date-range code blocks as calendars with color-coded entries, a legend, and a today marker.
